whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: But her biggest and most ambitious job today was this Sports Illustrated cover celebrating the magazine's Sportsman of the Year, Michael Jordan. Michael Jordan made me look good and that job came very quickly and because of my experience doing, which there's very few people that have any experience, you know, shooting people for holograms, I got the job to do that and he was great to work with. And Sharon made the most of the meeting. Yeah, I asked Michael if he would pose for me for a 360 degree hologram and he was really interested in the holographic process. Even though he was playing a game that night and had worked out that morning, I gave him one of those for him and his wife, one of those for Christmas. And she said, my gosh, he can buy anything he wants. If I knew you'd made this, I would have bought it. I could have given him something he couldn't buy. They're literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally literally Thank you.
